about: The key steps ch_open_song presses to start a song from the main menu, written from the manual and not yet tried on the game. Live step LS1 of docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-30-ch-mcp-star-power-and-song-start.md presses them one at a time, corrects this file in a one-file data commit, sets verified to true and settles each unproven mark. menu_tools.py says how a step is read.

steps.name: profile and game mode
steps.manual: Keyboard and Gamepads: "You need to press Start and select a profile using Strum Up/Down and Green before you can navigate the menus." Its table: Start/Pause is Enter, Green is A. How to Play: "Once you select your game mode you are then shown your current song list to choose from."
steps.guess: Enter opens the profile menu and the first Green picks the highlighted profile. The second Green picks the highlighted main menu item, guessed to be Quickplay; the manual does not name the item order. Whether a live SongSelect object means the song list is on screen is unproven.

steps.name: search
steps.manual: How to Play: "short press the Blue fret to open the search tool!" Keyboard and Gamepads table: Blue is K, Strum Up/Down are the arrow keys.
steps.guess: The search box takes the typed name, and Down moves through the results. Neither page says which key the search box takes text from.

steps.name: confirm the song
steps.manual: How to Play: "Once you select a song, you are then prompted to select your instrument, the difficulty, and apply modifiers." Keyboard and Gamepads: "then use Green to confirm your selection."
steps.guess: Green on the selected song opens the player screen. Whether a live PlayerSelectionMenu object means that screen is on screen is unproven.

steps.name: ready
steps.manual: Keyboard and Gamepads: "then use Green to confirm your selection."
steps.guess: The manual does not say what the Ready press is. Green is guessed, with the player screen's default instrument and difficulty.

steps.name: song loads
steps.manual: No press: this step waits for the loaded song.
steps.guess: The game loads the song with no further key.
